headline: PM Tarique Rahman visits Mongla and Khulna for port development and sports
summary: The Prime Minister will oversee the signing of a MoU between Invest Bangladesh and China Railway Construction Corporation and open Notun Kuri Sports Season 2.
details: Prime Minister Tarique Rahman has left Dhaka by helicopter for Mongla in Bagerhat to attend a series of official engagements before traveling to Khulna.
At Mongla Port, the PM will attend a signing ceremony for a memorandum of understanding between Invest Bangladesh and China Railway Construction Corporation.
He is also scheduled to lay the foundation stone for two new container jetties at the port to enhance its capacity.
Following his activities in Mongla, the Prime Minister will travel by road to Khulna to attend the opening ceremony of Notun Kuri Sports Season 2 at the district stadium.
The Prime Minister is expected to return to the capital by helicopter later this afternoon.
caption:
From port infrastructure to youth sports, PM Tarique Rahman is on a daylong visit to Bagerhat and Khulna.

Prime Minister Tarique Rahman has left Dhaka by helicopter for Mongla in Bagerhat to attend a series of official engagements before traveling to Khulna.

At Mongla Port, the PM will attend a signing ceremony for a memorandum of understanding between Invest Bangladesh and China Railway Construction Corporation.

He is also scheduled to lay the foundation stone for two new container jetties at the port to enhance its capacity.

Following his activities in Mongla, the Prime Minister will travel by road to Khulna to attend the opening ceremony of Notun Kuri Sports Season 2 at the district stadium.

The Prime Minister is expected to return to the capital by helicopter later this afternoon.

headline_marked: Actress [[Pori Moni to surrender in court]] today after arrest warrant
headline: Actress Pori Moni to surrender in court today after arrest warrant
summary: The actress announced her appearance following the cancellation of her bail and the issuance of a warrant by the court in a case filed by businessman Nasir Uddin Mahmud.
details: Film actress Pori Moni has announced that she will appear in court this Thursday after a warrant was issued for her arrest.
The court's order came yesterday following the cancellation of her bail in a case filed by businessman Nasir Uddin Mahmud.
Pori Moni stated that since a warrant has been issued, she will attend the court proceedings to address the legal matter.
The actress expressed that the ongoing legal battles over the last five years have placed significant pressure on her professional and family life.
She questioned whether these legal challenges would continue indefinitely, reflecting on her frequent court appearances.
Previously, the court had scheduled a date for witness testimony in the Mahmud case, but Pori Moni failed to appear.
Her lawyer, Nilanjana Rifat, had filed an application for time, stating that the actress was unable to attend due to allergy-related health issues.
caption:
After a warrant was issued for her arrest, actress Pori Moni is heading back to court today.

Film actress Pori Moni has announced that she will appear in court this Thursday after a warrant was issued for her arrest.

The court's order came yesterday following the cancellation of her bail in a case filed by businessman Nasir Uddin Mahmud.

Pori Moni stated that since a warrant has been issued, she will attend the court proceedings to address the legal matter.

The actress expressed that the ongoing legal battles over the last five years have placed significant pressure on her professional and family life.

She questioned whether these legal challenges would continue indefinitely, reflecting on her frequent court appearances.

Previously, the court had scheduled a date for witness testimony in the Mahmud case, but Pori Moni failed to appear.

Her lawyer, Nilanjana Rifat, had filed an application for time, stating that the actress was unable to attend due to allergy-related health issues.
